title: Grep

fields.name: regex
fields.description: Keep records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression.

fields.name: exclude
fields.description: Exclude records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression.

fields.name: logical_op
fields.description: Specify a logical operator: AND, OR or legacy (default).

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Grep Filter plugin lets you match or exclude specific records based on regular expression patterns for values or nested values.
